action_space_version: WC: M x (K+1) joint; NC: M rec-only + popularity caching heuristic
reward_version: hit=1/miss=0; WC adds PBRS Phi scaled 0.1 (policy-invariant); NC raw
optimizer_config: AdamW; sigma group lr=5e-5 wd=0; rest lr=1e-4 wd=1e-3; grad clip 5.0

cache_hit_MICRO.definition: total hits / total steps, pooled over eval episodes

seeding_protocol: set_seed(seed) + rebuild a fresh Environment before each agent's train AND before each agent's eval -> paired init on a clean env + identical eval episodes across agents within a seed (Environment.__init__ is RNG-free in tuple mode)
env_lifecycle: fresh Environment rebuilt per run (per agent, per train/eval phase)
